svg.title: Economic paths, seen early and later

cc:Work.dc:title: Economic paths, seen early and later
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Full-policy paths through day 425 • Common dollar scale across all panels Gold uses only postings visible at the origin and stops there; it is not a forecast or complete economic history. Shaded past remains uncertain because response, posting and revision delays separate the ledger from economic truth. The dashed truth path is evaluator-only. Fan widths include modeled parameter and future-event uncertainty, not all possible model failures.
